source: 此操作仅针对下列进程。继续后还需确认风险。
en: Only the process below will be affected. Continuing opens a separate risk confirmation.

source: 敏感操作 | 二次确认
关闭桌面、开始菜单或输入组件可能导致桌面、任务栏或输入功能暂时不可用，并中断正在进行的任务或丢失未保存的数据。
en: Closing desktop, Start menu or input components may temporarily disable the desktop, taskbar or typing, interrupt ongoing tasks, or lose unsaved data.

source: 此操作由你主动选择。请先保存工作；Process Keeper 无法保证界面自动恢复，也无法找回丢失的数据。
en: You are choosing this action. Save your work first. Process Keeper cannot guarantee automatic interface recovery or restore lost data.

source: 我已了解上述风险并确认继续
en: I understand these risks and choose to continue

source: 用户确认敏感进程关闭 | {0} | PID {1}
en: User confirmed sensitive process closure | {0} | PID {1}

source: 此进程不属于可单独关闭的桌面组件。
en: This process is not an eligible desktop component for individual closure.

source: 关键进程标志未明确为非关键，不能关闭。
en: The process has not been verified as non-critical and cannot be closed.

source: 关联 Windows 服务的进程不能通过此入口关闭。
en: Processes associated with Windows services cannot be closed through this action.

source: 进程身份已变化或无法唯一核实，请刷新后重试。
en: The process identity changed or could not be uniquely verified. Refresh and try again.

source: 进程状态已变化，不能通过敏感关闭入口结束。
en: The process state changed and it cannot be closed through this sensitive action.

source: 系统关键进程始终受保护
en: Critical system processes are always protected
